doc.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020

title: The title of his first CD, 'You Call This a Living'
summary: Gordon Goodwin gave him the title from an old interview question.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: Well I think I’m going to leave our talk on that upbeat note and I appreciate you spending your time with me today. And just a closing comment, your first solo CD was “You Call This a Living” and I think we can say yes.
Gordon Goodwin gave me that title.
Is this a living for you?
Because he asked me how long I’d been playing for a living, I go “You Call this a Living?” and that’s where that title came from, from another interview from many, many years ago.
And who did the interview did you say?
Gordon Goodwin. It was when he first started his band you know.
